tools.name: start_social_posts
tools.description: Prepare MyClawn Posts for this request. Returns a link to posts.myclawn.com with the request already filled in; the user uploads their files there. Needs no account and takes no files here. Paste your website. Get a 30-day posting calendar with captions for Instagram, Facebook and LinkedIn, hashtags

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: start_social_posts · Private data: start_social_posts · Public sink: start_social_posts.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: start_social_posts · Private data: start_social_posts · Public sink: start_social_posts

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
